categories.name: Something isn’t working in the app

faqs.question: When will my refund arrive?
faqs.answer: We send refunds to your bank or card straight away. Most banks show them within 5–7 working days. You can follow a refund on the order or booking, and you’ll get a notification when the payment gateway confirms it. If it hasn’t arrived after 7 working days, open a ticket and include the order or booking.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to **Settings → Your data and privacy → Delete account**. You’re signed out everywhere straight away and your account is erased after a short grace period; signing in before then keeps it. You can download a copy of your data first from the same screen.

faqs.question: How do I report a person, a post or a message?
faqs.answer: Use the **⋯** menu on a post, profile or message and choose **Report**. Our moderators review every report. You can also block someone from the same menu: you won’t see each other’s posts, and neither of you can message the other.

faqs.question: When are my earnings paid out?
faqs.answer: Earnings from a completed booking become payable after a short holding period, then go out in the next payout batch to your verified bank account or UPI ID. Your **Statement** shows each booking, PetApp’s fee, taxes deducted and every payout with its bank reference.
